decisions.reason: As a flagship waterproof lined range close to the core offer, it likely meets aspiration levels and anchors the firm's strategic direction, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

An ESD occupational shoe fills a standard workplace requirement close to the established offer, and the firm's slack lets it carry the single model even if results are modest, though model turnover in footwear makes replacement by a successor somewhat likely.

A multi-model safety shoe series in the core business is cheap to keep and probably near aspiration, but footwear collections are refreshed regularly, so some risk remains that it is phased out for newer lines.
